articles.title: Kalshi rolls out Midterm Hubs ahead of the November elections in the U.S.
articles.snippet: The prediction markets platform seeks to position itself as the primary source for election odds ahead of the midterm elections this year.

articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act still at mercy of ethics section as Democrats balk at Trump deal
articles.snippet: The White House has circulated some details of the conflict-of-interest limits the president agreed to with Republican negotiators, but talks are still underway.

articles.title: Zilliqa Ledger app vulnerability lets attackers recover signer’s private keys
articles.snippet: A security vulnerability in the Zilliqa Ledger app is enabling attackers to reconstruct private keys using publicly available onchain data.

articles.title: CLARITY Act could help CFTC deal with prediction markets: Lawyer
articles.snippet: According to one lawyer testifying before a House subcommittee hearing, the CLARITY Act could grant the CFTC the authority it needs to address the “explosive growth of prediction markets.”

articles.title: Jack Dorsey's Block Launches Buzz, a Nostr-Based Slack and GitHub Rival for AI Agents
articles.snippet: The free, open source workspace runs on Nostr, gives AI agents their own cryptographic identities, and challenges Slack and GitHub.
